name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

 ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
 Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
 through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
 open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

 PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
 Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
 may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
 Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
 are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
 management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
 the presiding officer.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
 4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
 Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
 agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
 see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83092891902
  Webinar ID: 830 9289 1902
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83092891902# OR +16699009128,,83092891902#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of July 10, 2024 City Council Regular Session, July 24, 2024 Study Session and
Regular Session, and August 21, 2024 Special Session Meeting Minutes.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

  1. Moment of Silence in Memory of the Victims from September 11, 2001

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None

PUBLIC HEARINGS: None
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective August 1, 2024 in the amount
  of $917,717.67, August 15, 2024 in the amount of $622,960.98 and September 1,
  2023 in the amount of $431,441.59.

  TREASURERS QUARTERLY REPORT: File and Receive CalPERS Report
  dated June 30, 2024; Stifel Report dated June 30, 2024

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ASSIGNMENT OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT FOR
  LEGISLATIVE CONSULTING SERVICES - Approve the assignment of a
  Professional Services Agreement from Renne Public Law Group to
  California Public Policy Group for legislative consulting services.

  2.  APPROVAL OF REVISIONS TO THE CITY’S JOB DESCRIPTIONS;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2363-24 - Approve Resolution No. 2363-24 Approving
  Revisions to all Current Job Descriptions.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2363-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADOPTING AMENDED JOB DESCRIPTIONS
  FOR CERTAIN POSITIONS IN THE CITY

  3.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF THE MEASURE W SAFE, CLEAN
  WATER PROGRAM MUNICIPAL TRANSFER AGREEMENT BETWEEN
  THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AND THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT - Approve the Measure W Safe, Clean
  Water Program Municipal Transfer Agreement between the City of
  Westlake Village and Los Angeles County Flood Control District and
  authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the agreement on behalf of the
  City.

  4.  ACCEPTANCE OF LANDSCAPE IRRIGATION CONTROLLERS
  INSTALLED BY SITEONE LANDSCAPE SUPPLY; FILE NOTICE OF
  COMPLETION - Accept the completed construction of the landscape
  irrigation controllers by SiteOne and authorize the City Clerk to execute and
  record a “Notice of Completion” on behalf of the City.

  5.  ACCEPTANCE OF CANYON OAKS PARK SHADE STRUCTURE
  INSTALLED BY EVERGREEN ENVIRONMENT, INC.; FILE NOTICE OF
  COMPLETION - Accept the completed construction of the Canyon Oaks
  Shade Structure by Evergreen Environment and authorize the City Clerk to
  execute and record a “Notice of Completion” on behalf of the City.
 OLD BUSINESS:

1.  APPROVING THE 2024 LAS VIRGENES-MALIBU COUNCIL OF
  GOVERNMENT MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL HAZARD MITIGATION PLAN;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2364-24 - Adopt Resolution 2364-24 approving the 2024 Las
  Virgenes-Malibu Council of Government Multi-Jurisdictional Hazard Mitigation
  Plan.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2364-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADOPTING THE 2024 MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL HAZARD
  MITIGATION PLAN OF THE LAS VIRGENES-MALIBU COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 306-24 ADOPTING LOS ANGELES
  COUNTY CODE TITLE 10 (ANIMALS) BY REFERENCE WITH AMENDMENTS
  - Ordinance No. 306-24 be introduced by title only and that further reading be
  waived and that a Public Hearing be scheduled for October 9, 2024 for the
  Ordinance second reading.

  ORDINANCE NO. 306-24: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE,
  CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING BY REFERENCE TITLE 10 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  CODE, TITLE 10 (ANIMALS) AND AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL
  CODE CHAPTER 3.3 – ANIMAL CONTROL REGULATIONS

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, September 5, 2024 at 4:30 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.

Amended Agenda, adjusting title for Special Presentation, posted on Thursday, September 5,
2024 at 5:15 p.m. on the City’s website and in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  September 5, 2024
